style.backgroundSystem: only three flat planes across the whole set, each screen dominated by one of them: a charcoal-slate wet-stone ground #2E3A3C carrying the overhead opening, the pain-point table and the pairing screens; a misty celadon glaze field #6E94A0 carrying the macro screen and the parameter-table screen; a pale rice-paper band #E7EBE3 with visible fibre flecks carrying the benefit, comparison, seal-frame and closing screens. One dominant plane per screen with one hairline or dashed rule where it meets a second plane; no warm brown wood plane as a background, no marble, no pure seamless studio sweep #FFFFFF, no gradient glow, no landscape scenery, no wavy die-cut paper edge
style.direction: cool misty-slate Chinese dried-goods detail-page commerce with ink-serif editorial layout
style.iconSystem: hand-inked single-weight botanical line sketches of a split piece and a seed pod, one per screen maximum, drawn in slate #2E3A3C on the pale band and in pale #E7EBE3 on the dark ground; hairline right-angle frames that bleed across a photo edge, dashed hairline rules and one square bracket pair as the only layout devices; no dotted caption circles, no wavy die-cut bands, no solid disc badges, no shields, crosses, flames or body diagrams
style.lightingSystem: cool diffuse north-daylight key between 6000K and 6200K from the upper left, a soft bounce fill on the shadow side, matte low-specular read on dry pieces, wet sheen permitted only on cooked pieces sitting in clear liquor, one defined soft contact shadow that always grounds every vessel, a thin steam wisp allowed on cooked screens, never a warm amber cast, never a flat shadowless beauty look, never a hard glossy plastic sheen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool misty-slate Chinese dried-goods ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a charcoal wet-slate ground #2E3A3C, a pale rice-paper band #E7EBE3 with visible fibre flecks, a misty celadon field #6E94A0 and one rouge-red accent #A43C4B; cool tone throughout; cool diffuse north-daylight key between 6000K and 6200K from the upper left with a soft bounce fill, matte low-specular read on dry pieces, wet sheen permitted only on cooked pieces in clear liquor, one defined soft contact shadow grounding every vessel; only three flat planes per set with one hairline or dashed rule where they meet, no wood-grain or terracotta background plane, no pure seamless studio white, no marble, no gradient glow, no scenery, no wavy die-cut paper edge; one Chinese Ming-style serif for headline placeholders plus one vertical caption column set inside a hairline right-angle square frame, hand-inked single-weight botanical line sketch as the only ornament, dashed hairline rules as dividers, no dotted caption circles, no solid disc badges, no geometric sans-serif display face; dry pieces read hard, chalky-matte and pale ivory with an open split cleft, cooked pieces read plump and whole in a clear pale liquor, never glossy, never plastic; the same beaded-rim celadon plate recurs at constant scale across the set; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no warm amber cast on any screen
no mixed fonts and no geometric sans-serif used as the display face
no wavy die-cut paper band, no dotted caption circles, no solid disc badges
no wood-grain or terracotta background plane, no pure seamless studio white, no marble, no gradient field
no glossy wet sheen on dry pieces and no plastic-looking food
no inconsistent lighting, no missing or impossible contact shadow, no floating vessel
no visible brand mark, QR code, membership badge, promotional corner tag or contact detail
no printed origin name, grade, size term, net weight, piece count, duration, nutrition figure, test result, certification or efficacy wording
style.presentationRules: the same beaded-rim celadon plate recurs as the identity anchor at constant scale; dry pieces always read hard, chalky-matte and pale ivory with one open split cleft, cooked pieces read plump, whole and unbroken with translucent edges in a clear pale liquor; every vessel grounded by a contact shadow; nothing bleached, glossy, wet-looking or recoloured; text never crosses a piece; no piece stacked into an unnatural mound
style.surfaceSystem: charcoal wet-slate counter #2E3A3C, blue-grey celadon-glazed stoneware plate with a beaded stud rim #6E94A0, shallow unglazed clay bowl #9C6B4F, weathered woven bamboo basket and colander #C2A878, undyed grey herringbone linen cloth #B9BCB4, pale porcelain bowl with one small side handle #E7EBE3, pale wooden scoop #9B7245, cured leaf #7E8C73, closed pale flower bud #E7C3CC, loose green fern sprigs #3C5040, pale rice-paper board #E7EBE3, misty celadon matte board #6E94A0
style.typography: one Chinese Ming-style serif for headline placeholders plus one single-column vertical caption set inside a hairline right-angle square frame, rouge-red #A43C4B or slate #2E3A3C lettering on the pale band #E7EBE3 and pale #E7EBE3 lettering on the slate ground #2E3A3C; headline 28-48pt, one sub-line 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, one weight per screen; every rendered word is a placeholder; no geometric sans-serif as the display face, no latin brand lettering, no handwritten body copy, no more than one vertical caption column per screen, no dense paragraph text
